# results

Generated output. Committed so that every claim in the documents is checkable.

Current contents are produced by `/research/analysis` and are pure arithmetic and simulation —
no fitted data, no strategy results yet.

Experiment output lands in `/results/<EXP-ID>/` with the structure in
[BACKTESTING_PROTOCOL.md](../BACKTESTING_PROTOCOL.md) §8.

**Do not edit generated files by hand. Re-run the script.**
